item.title: Indian Bank Apprentice Online Form 2026
item.description:
Post Name Total Posts Eligibility Criteria
Apprentice 1,500
  • Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
  • Graduation must have been completed between 01/04/2022 and 01/11/2026.
  • Final graduation result must have been declared on or before 01/11/2026.
  • Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and other eligible categories as per Government rules.
  • Candidates must register on the NATS 2.0 portal before applying.
  • Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training or are currently pursuing apprenticeship training are not eligible.
  • Knowledge of the local language of the selected State/UT is required.
Total 1,500 For additional eligibility criteria, candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully.

item.title: Canara Bank Apprentice Vacancy 2026
item.description:
Canara Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Short Details
Post Name Total Posts Educational Qualification
Graduate Apprentice 3500 Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university. Candidates must have completed graduation between 01 January 2023 and 01 September 2026. Minimum 60% marks in 12th/Diploma (55% for SC/ST/PwBD). Age: 20–28 years as on 01 September 2026, with applicable age relaxation.

Note: For detailed eligibility criteria and other requirements, candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully.
